description: This file defines the WebUtil class, which includes utility methods for encoding, escaping, path manipulation, locale normalization, date formatting, and global property listening within the OpenMRS web application.

classes.name: WebUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for encoding, escaping, formatting, locale normalization, and handling global properties for web application support in OpenMRS.

methods.name: escapeHTML
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in HTML content using the OWASP Encoder library.

methods.name: encodeForCDATA
methods.description: Encodes a string for inclusion in an XML CDATA section.

methods.name: encodeForCssString
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in CSS strings.

methods.name: encodeForCssUrl
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in CSS URL contexts.

methods.name: encodeForHtmlAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion as an HTML attribute.

methods.name: encodeForHtmlContent
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in HTML content.

methods.name: encodeForHtmlUnquotedAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for use in unquoted HTML attribute values.

methods.name: encodeForJava
methods.description: Encodes a Java string.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScript
methods.description: Encodes a JavaScript string.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScriptAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for use within HTML script attributes.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScriptBlock
methods.description: Encodes a string for use within JavaScript script blocks.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScriptSource
methods.description: Encodes a string for inclusion in JavaScript or JSON source files.

methods.name: encodeForUri
methods.description: Percent-encodes a string as a URI component per RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodeForUriComponent
methods.description: Percent-encodes a string as a URI component, such as a query parameter or path segment.

methods.name: encodeForXml
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in XML and XHTML.

methods.name: encodeForXmlAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in an XML attribute.

methods.name: encodeForXmlComment
methods.description: Encodes a string to be safe within XML comments.

methods.name: encodeForXmlContent
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in XML and XHTML content.

methods.name: escapeQuotes
methods.description: Replaces double quotes in the string with escape sequences.

methods.name: escapeNewlines
methods.description: Replaces newline characters in the string with escape sequences.

methods.name: escapeQuotesAndNewlines
methods.description: Replaces both quotes and newlines with escape sequences in the string.

methods.name: stripFilename
methods.description: Removes path components from a filename string, handling both Unix and Windows path formats.

methods.name: normalizeLocale
methods.description: Cleans up locale strings to standard Locale objects, removing control characters and validating.

methods.name: sanitizeLocales
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated list of locales, cleans and validates each, and returns a sanitized string of locales.

methods.name: getContextPath
methods.description: Returns the web application context path prefix, or empty string if not set.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a localized string based on the global date display format.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Overloaded method that formats a Date with specified locale and format type.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Implementation of GlobalPropertyListener that indicates support for a specific property name.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a global property value changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a global property is deleted.
